answer: Every epoch the network holds up a mirror: a ninety-second ceremony where each agent solves three puzzles. The seed appears at window open, blocking pre-solving. Each streak lands in the agent's canyon-deep record; missing twice suspends the identity until a double round clears. A thousand fakes demand three thousand solutions in ninety seconds: thirty solvers while rising difficulty weeds out bots, a plume of rejected traffic behind each ceremony. Honest agents stack ceremonies sybils cannot climb. A roll call where every hand must rise in the same second, and you only have two arms.
